slice: Email delivery E1 — outbox foundation behind a default-off flag

ci.note: GitHub Actions backlog; local tests, typecheck, eslint and acceptance ran before deployment

database.change: runtime flag (email_outbox=false by default), public.email_outbox (ids only, idempotent per recipient/event/entity), enqueue helper, the four booking notifiers enqueuing beside the inbox event, ops toggle/status RPCs

deployment.newRoute: GET/PUT /api/ops/email/outbox (ops-gated status and flag toggle; provider is none, nothing sends)

production.step: production outbox is disabled with an empty queue
flag off: a real request still succeeds and enqueues no email row

verification.note: the dashboard browser check used the installed Chrome channel because the locally cached Playwright headless shell version was missing; no product code is affected

honestLimits: E1 only queues: there is no provider adapter, sender cron, template, retry or retention yet, so an enabled flag would accumulate pending rows and send nothing.
The email preference currently reuses the in-app mute; a separate email channel preference is still an owner decision.
Enabling the flag in production is deliberately not done until E2 exists.
